outcome: umbilical cord arterial blood gas parameters (pressure of oxygen, acidosis)
cohort: 200 women who gave birth by cesarean section, 100 with MSAF and 100 with normal amniotic fluid
finding: Neonates with MSAF had lower pressure of oxygen than those without, but there was no difference in acidosis.
mod_finding: MSAF is an event that occurs during labor and delivery.
